year_population_blockers.finding: Public FDA sources expose action records and selected review files. They do not enumerate every application and review goal across pending, private, delayed or undisclosed cases. Other calendar counts differ and include action dates or placeholders.
year_population_blockers.next_action: Acquire a disclosed exact-goal export and original filing sources for the claimed provisional cohort. Match them to public application IDs and track any inaccessible targets as unobservable.

year_population_blockers.finding: Pending claims frequently omit the application or supplement number, and some candidates lack a direct goal source or have approximate dates.
year_population_blockers.next_action: Crosswalk official filing notices, action letters and sponsor disclosures to exact cycle, supplement and indication. Review unresolved aliases before counting them.

year_population_blockers.finding: Most FDA action letters and calendar rows do not contain pivotal estimates, tests or comparative safety.
year_population_blockers.next_action: Obtain indication-matched pivotal protocols, dated registry versions, trial publications and FDA reviews. Record nulls and blockers when results are inaccessible.

year_population_blockers.finding: No eligible historical Level 1 comparisons were established. The contemporaneous HARMONi pilot belongs to a separate research series.
year_population_blockers.next_action: Locate immutable pre-action Level 1 versions and contemporaneous evidence manifests. Verify exact cycle and earliest public outcome before scoring.

year_population_blockers.finding: The collection date is November 18, before the end of the 2026 calendar year.
year_population_blockers.next_action: Append a new dated snapshot after year-end and reconcile late announcements, additional decisions and amendments.

identity_or_goal_blockers.reason: FDA letter confirms S-013 approval for the age-related stage 2 diabetes label change on April 20. April 29 appears in the calendar but no S-013 primary goal document was located. The S-010/S-014 review concerns separate June actions.
Drugs@FDA identifies NDA 218197/S-004 for the June 12 CAPItello-281 action. S-006 is a later supplement. The June 30 calendar claim remains an unverified goal.
FDA confirms NDA 218881/S-001. Exact PDUFA goal and amendment history remain unverified.
FDA action on the idiopathic-nephrotic-syndrome supplement is established. The attributed September 25 date matches the action and lacks an independent goal-date source.
Drugs@FDA identifies NDA 216059/S-006 as the October 2 approval for first-line CLL/SLL. The exact PDUFA goal remains unverified.
FDA labeling identifies NDA 218436/S-001 for symptomatic dermographism. October 6 is the action date, and an exact PDUFA goal is still unverified.
Merck confirms the October 10-goal small cell lung cancer application was voluntarily withdrawn September 25 after FDA feedback. The exact BLA number remains unavailable.
Drugs@FDA confirms NDA 221291 and November 9 approval. A cited date is the public action, and an independently identified exact review goal is still needed.

Drugs@FDA confirms NDA 220414 and November 10 effective approval date. The calendar action cannot establish the exact PDUFA goal. FDA’s novel-approvals index separately lists November 13. Retain the November 10 application action and reconcile the index discrepancy before using either date as a goal.
Savara discloses the original August 22 and revised November 22 goal. Exact pending BLA/STN was not found in the reviewed 10-Q, FDA listings or IMPALA-2 trial material.
Sanofi’s priority-review notice confirms November 25 for type 3 Gaucher disease. The pending original NDA number was not disclosed in that notice or identified in the FDA snapshot.
BridgeBio’s filing identifies the priority NDA for LGMD2I/R9 and November 27. The filing does not disclose the pending FDA application number.

November 27 is sponsor-disclosed and FDA announced accelerated approval November 17 for the labeled indication. The exact NDA number was absent from the prior-day archive and FDA notification reviewed.

identity_or_goal_blockers.drug: D-PLEX100 - prevention of surgical site infections
identity_or_goal_blockers.reason: PolyPid discloses November 28 for the priority surgical-site-infection NDA. The exact pending NDA number is not public in the reviewed filing.
Cogent discloses November 30 for PEAK and a distinct December 30 date for SUMMIT. The PEAK pending NDA number was not established.
Regeneron materials give a November decision window for cemdisiran in gMG. The calendar maps the window to November 30; confirm exact goal, approved or pending path and NDA identity.
FDA and Genentech confirm approval November 13 and Drugs@FDA lists S-044. The sponsor materials reviewed do not turn the November window into a confirmed November 30 goal.
Genentech confirms November 30 for adjuvant early breast cancer. The exact pending lidERA NDA number is unverified. The advanced evERA approval cannot supply that identity.
FDA confirms the 2026 accelerated HER2 NSCLC supplement action on September 9 and a separate 2025 original action. Neither establishes the asserted November 30 goal.
Vertex confirms November 30 for the priority accelerated IgA nephropathy BLA. The exact pending BLA number was not established from FDA sources.
Vanda confirms December 12 for the GPP BLA. The filing does not disclose the exact pending BLA/STN.
Mineralys confirms December 22 for the hypertension NDA. The exact pending application number is absent from the acceptance filing.
Arcellx filing establishes December 23 for fourth-line or later myeloma; the pending BLA/STN was not located in public filings.
Viatris reports a December 27 goal for the acute-pain NDA. An exact pending NDA number was not established from FDA data or the sponsor filing.
Praxis documents the major amendment and extension from September 27 to December 27. The pending NDA number is not identified in its reviewed filing.
Cogent confirms December 30 for SUMMIT nonadvanced mastocytosis. The exact pending NDA number is unverified and the PEAK combination cannot be used to substitute.
Novo gives a fourth-quarter decision expectation. December 31 is calendar normalization; the exact FDA target and pending application number remain unverified.

The lupus ALLEGORY application is distinct from the idiopathic and membranous nephropathy supplements. The December 31 calendar value remains a window placeholder without exact target or supplement evidence.
Drugs@FDA records the September 16, 2026 approval of NDA 215341/S-011. The FDA label matches CKD associated with type 1 diabetes. The December 31 calendar date remains unverified as a goal.
FDA confirms BLA 761108/S-046 for proteinuria in adult primary IgA nephropathy. Exact goal and amendment history remain unavailable.
